name: Daallo Forest
story: Daallo Forest is a national park located in the eastern Sanaag region of Somaliland, forming part of the Ogo Mountains. The reserve features an unspoiled wilderness with dense evergreen forest on a limestone and gypsum escarpment, where some trees are over 1000 years old.
matters: The site is designated an Important Bird Area by BirdLife International and supports high-elevation species and characteristic fauna of the North Somali mountains such as the endemic Warsangli linnet.
